type.enum: One of a set of values
visibilityHint.public: read wherever its record is, My Documents included
editor.keyFormat: Lower-case letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
editor.documentHelp: True of the document whatever attempt is made, such as its size.
editor.attemptHelp: Chosen for one attempt, such as the machine it is scanned on.
editor.fixedSuffix: Records hold values of it, so what it is about and its type stay.
editor.list: A list: a record may hold several values
editor.catalogFactHelp: The catalog holds it. A mistake is repaired in the catalog and read again with Recheck.
editor.handValueHelp: The tier a hand value gets. The highest tier with a value is the one in use, so above a plugin's tier a hand value wins over it. Each property has its own permission to enter it, given on Users management.
editor.refusal.keyTaken: That key is or was in use. A key is never used twice.
editor.refusal.inUse: Records hold values of it, so its type and what it is about stay.
editor.refusal.valueInUse: A value records hold cannot be taken out.
editor.refusal.catalogFact: The catalog holds it: it is repaired there, never entered by hand.
propertiesPage.title: Properties
propertiesPage.givePermission: Give {{permission}} on Users management to whoever enters it.
propertiesPage.deleteNotice: {{name}} and its key are gone; the key is never used again.
propertiesPage.predefinedNote: Predefined: counting, generating and the pages' filters read it, so it is edited but never deleted.
propertiesPage.noValuesHeld: No record holds a value of it.
propertiesPage.sharedWatchlistConditionR: {{name}} loses its condition on it and pauses until each recipient confirms.
propertiesPage.intentionConditionRemoved: {{name}} loses its condition on it, and counts more from then on.
propertiesPage.keyRetired: The key {{key}} is never used again.
propertiesPage.predefinedRefusal: A predefined property is edited, never deleted.
propertiesCard.title: Properties
propertiesCard.scanned: It is scanned, so what it was scanned with stays as it is.
propertyValueDialog.details.document: Set on the document, whatever attempt is made. A hand value has tier {{tier}}; the highest tier with a value is the one in use, and every source stays visible.
propertyValueDialog.details.documentBulk: Set on the document, whatever attempt is made. A hand value has tier {{tier}}; the highest tier with a value is the one in use, and every source stays visible. Documents that refuse it are listed afterwards.
propertyValueDialog.details.attempt: Set on the current attempt. Once it is scanned the value stays. A hand value has tier {{tier}}; the highest tier with a value is the one in use, and every source stays visible.
propertyValueDialog.details.attemptBulk: Set on the current attempt. Once it is scanned the value stays. A hand value has tier {{tier}}; the highest tier with a value is the one in use, and every source stays visible. Documents that refuse it are listed afterwards.
propertyValueDialog.refusal.scanned: This attempt is scanned; what it was scanned with stays.
propertyValueDialog.refusal.forbidden: You may no longer enter this property.
scopeCondition.add: Add a condition on a property
scopeCondition.help: All of them hold for an item it counts. A digitized item is read as it was on its digitized date, so a later change does not move what was counted.
scopeCondition.helpIncomplete: All of them hold for an item it counts. A digitized item is read as it was on its digitized date, so a later change does not move what was counted. A condition with nothing chosen yet is not saved.
